autoTracking.title: Automatic draft tracking
autoTracking.description: Automates the whole draft flow: the initial pool scan, your spot and hero model selection, and targeted rescans after every pick with per-player pick tracking.
autoTracking.gsiNote: This feature relies on Dota 2's built-in Game State Integration (GSI). With the config file installed, your game sends draft information (game phase, draft clock, your slot and picked hero) to this app. The connection is local-only and strictly one-way — the app never sends anything to the game and nothing leaves your PC. GSI is an official Valve feature used by broadcast tools and carries no ban risk.
autoTracking.delayHint: How long to wait after the draft is detected before scanning the pool automatically ({{min}}–{{max}}s). Fast PCs are fine with 5s; slower machines may need up to 30s for the draft screen to fully render.
autoTracking.buttonsNote: While enabled, the manual My Spot and My Model overlay buttons are hidden — both selections happen automatically from game data.
autoTracking.setupHint: One-time: install the config file below into your Dota folder, then restart Dota 2.
